name: memory_recall
description: Associative memory recall over linked markdown notes. Retrieves relevant context using vector search, 1-hop [[wikilink]] graph expansion, ordered by dense similarity (cross-encoder rerank is opt-in). Returns a formatted context bundle.

query.description: The search query or topic to retrieve memory for.

mode.description: Retrieval mode: 'associative' (vector + graph expansion, recommended), 'direct' (vector search only), or 'ab' (run both and log comparison telemetry).
